title: Spirit, the wild horse.
lines: She lives in the big city with her aunt and her grandpa.
Lucky's mum was a famous rider.
She did tricks on a horse, in the circus.
But Lucky never knew her mum.
She was still a baby when her mum died.
One day Lucky goes on a trip with her aunt.
To the little town of Miradero, in the Wild West.
Lucky doesn't know him very well.
The train goes through wide fields, past mountains and rivers.
Lucky looks out of the window.
A whole herd, galloping alongside the train.
Their manes are flying in the wind.
In front runs a beautiful horse.
He's brown, with a black mane and a black tail.
And it's as if they've known each other for years.
In Miradero she sees the horse again.
Men have caught him with lassos.
He won't let anyone on his back.
Lucky creeps up to the fence.
She talks softly to the horse.
He lets her stroke his nose.
He eats it out of her hand.
Because he has a wild, free spirit.
Lucky goes to see Spirit every day.
She brings him apples and carrots.
And slowly Spirit becomes her friend.
In Miradero Lucky meets two girls.
Pru is the daughter of the man who runs the stables.
She has been riding horses all her life.
She's calm and she knows everything about horses.
Abigail is very cheerful and a bit silly.
She talks all the time and she's always making jokes.
Lucky, says Pru, you mustn't force the horse.
You have to move together with the horse.
She looks him in the eyes.
Lucky carefully climbs onto his back.
Lucky holds on to his mane.
The wind blows through her hair.
He wants to sell Spirit and his whole herd.
He loads the horses onto a train.
He wants to take them far away.
Lucky, Pru and Abigail have to do something.
Pru on her horse Chica Linda.
They gallop alongside the moving train.
Spirit jumps out of the train.
And all the other horses jump out after him.
But there's nothing he can do anymore.
The horses gallop back to the mountains.
Spirit looks at Lucky one last time.
But every morning he comes back to the edge of the town.
And then they ride through the fields together.
And Spirit, who always stays free.
